draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling decodes faster than Talmar, with a median latency of 41 vs 118 ms per utterance.
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling reports a lower median latency than Talmar (41 vs 118 ms per utterance), though Brisling was measured on a Corvex A2 accelerator in fp16 while Talmar's latency is the value reported by Ruiz-Hale et al. (2023) on a Corvex A1 accelerator in fp32.
rationale: Numbers match T1 (41 vs 118 ms). However, the claim implies a direct speed comparison, but the latencies were measured on different hardware/precision (A2 fp16 vs A1 fp32), and Talmar was not re-timed. The claim should note this scope limitation.
